I have the test code ready. It directly implements the reproduction steps from the issue, specifically targeting the `repr` mismatch. I will now run this test to confirm it fails as expected at the current buggy commit.", "tool": "run_test", "args": {"source": "import tomlkit

def test_repro_issue_439():
    toml_content = """
a.b.c = "d"
a.b.e = "f"
"""
    
    a = tomlkit.parse(toml_content)
    value = a["a"]
    expected = {"b": {"c": "d", "e": "f"}}

    # This assertion should pass, showing that the equality check works
    assert value == expected

    # This assertion should fail due to the bug described in issue #439
    # The repr of value (an OutOfOrderTableProxy) is missing the 'c' key.
    assert repr(value) == repr(expected)
"}}
